locations.note: The Assassins' mountain fortress at Masyaf, Altaïr's home and the seat of Al Mualim, who demotes him and sends him after nine targets; the story ends here.
The botched mission at Solomon's Temple opens the game; later Altaïr hunts the slaver Talal in Jerusalem.
Crusader Acre: Garnier de Nablus, master of the Knights Hospitaller, experiments on the patients of his hospital.
Saracen-held Damascus: the arms dealer Tamir, who sells to both sides, and the regent Abu'l Nuquod.
The finale at Arsuf, on the battlefield of the Third Crusade, where Altaïr faces Robert de Sablé.

routes.name: Altaïr's nine targets
routes.note: From Solomon's Temple back to Masyaf, out to the three cities, and home for the last confrontation.
